_comment: Written by hand from each shelter's own write-up (data/shelter_descriptions.json). Only what the listing actually says. Compatibility appears here as structured fields, never inside notes, and only where the shelter states it outright -- silence stays null so an unassessed dog never renders as 'Not recommended'.

sfspca-59537273.notes: Playful and confident, and dives into everything — chasing toys, new smells, new people. Happiest being the centre of attention.

sfspca-59013011.notes: Always up for something — playtime, a jog, or entertaining herself. Then she'll lay her big head in your lap and talk your ear off.

sfspca-60716178.notes: Loves meeting new people and pounces on his toys. Entertains himself happily, takes treats, sits on cue, and is still learning not to jump.

sfspca-61200213.notes: Affectionate, playful and curious, with distinctly refined opinions about toys and dinner. The shelter doesn't suit him; a settled home will.

sfspca-61409760.notes: Lively, goofy and very treat-motivated. Loves learning and is always ready to practise, with all the energy of a teenager still figuring things out.

sfspca-49985119.notes: A smart goofball who already knows sit, down and stay, and may be crate trained. Eager on walks, but happy to check in for a snack.

sfspca-51187664.notes: Enjoys making friends and leaning in for a cuddle. Content to be a couch potato, and happy to try a walk if that's your thing.

sfspca-59958533.notes: All puppy energy — wiggles, jumps and playtime — and learning that puzzle toys work too. Takes a little while to warm up, then loves being by your side.

sfspca-39869815.notes: A quiet companion who prefers a slow life laying by your feet. Already well trained, and nervous about new people until they go at his pace.

sfspca-60580180.notes: Has one true passion in life, and it is fetch. Still a teenager, still learning to greet people politely, and requests at least one session a day.

sfspca-49881797.notes: A big, goofy boy who loves to explore, show off his zoomies and give kisses. Comes on strong because he doesn't know his own size.

sfspca-58381422.notes: Enthusiastic to a fault — he's actively unlearning the jumping and has got as far as sitting for joy instead. A fast learner.

sfspca-61030992.notes: Friendly to everyone she's met, with a repertoire of wiggles. Will lay her head in your lap or follow you around the house.

sfspca-30469611.notes: A senior who shows no signs of slowing down. Performs a meerkat act for attention, loves small plushies, and prefers to eat off a plate.

sfspca-60675147.notes: Happy-go-lucky and mad about anything stuffed. A smart, fast learner who's still a bit forward on leash, and will plop down beside you on the couch.

sfspca-61466803.notes: Shy but sweet, and taking her time with city life. Looking for someone willing to match her pace while she builds confidence.

sfspca-51832072.notes: Confident and curious, and knows exactly who he is. Treat-motivated, already knows his cues, and winds down happily with pets afterwards.

sfspca-50906698.notes: Takes a few days to warm up, then becomes an absolute lovebug. Whip-smart, knows her cues, and has wonderful leash manners.

sfspca-61128469.notes: Powerful-looking and an absolute goofball underneath. Sweet, gentle, and always pleased to welcome a new guest into the house.
